feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 May 2026 4:12am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland as a frontal system continues to clear the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, increasing 5 to 7 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain clearing towards the southeast to become fair. Isolated showers soon developing, becoming occasional later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest, soon veering northwest, 5 to 7, decreasing 4 to 6 overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, heavy at times.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.
